items.english: Tatsuya shook his head with an amused smile. "Now, what I have to say comes to just this. To be sure, in your way of thinking, if only the forwarding of the papers is hurried through, all else may be left for after, and there is reason enough in what you say, but as to those applications, that it is a case I cannot manage by myself however I try is as I have told you before. The Kunitomo Company's business was at first in my charge, but now the bureau chief has taken it in hand and stands openly as the patron of the Company in all things, so that once the application is ready tomorrow or in two or three days, on the day the Company presents it to the ministry there will be no good way to lie in wait on the road and hinder it. Hence before the matter comes to pass there is nothing for it but to draw that chief into our hands and talk him round into travelling to some distant place. While the chief is not in Tokyo, and from his place of travel holds the Company's application in check from afar so that it is not sent, I shall by my own contrivance make use of the head of the supervisory office, that man with the thick beard who came a while ago, set him to stand in the breach at this juncture, and without putting my hand to either side quietly pull the strings. But for that, should anything go amiss, the careers of we three must be sacrificed for your sake, and that after success would be one thing, but coming after the assignation-house affair you know of, should conduct of this sort be laid bare before society again, it would in truth be a bad business."
notes: Kept 'man with the thick beard' for the supervisory chief to hold the echo with Tatsuya's black beard and the black-bearded guests.

'The careers of we three must be sacrificed for your sake' follows the Japanese closely, but whether Tatsuya means risk undertaken for Zenpei or compensation owed by him is left unsettled in the sentence, and I have kept the risk sense.
'Assignation-house affair' renders the prior待合事件 as a previous scandal that raises the stakes here, without adding explanation beyond the text.
